_comment: Autonomous build queue for FFG Engine v2. v2_pipeline.py pops the next pending item per night (1:30-3:30 window) and builds it: claude -p generates schema-valid content, gates verify, assemble ships to games/. Only genres with registry status 'live' should be queued (tactics, battleship; topdown next). Each built game is an ORIGINAL-IP take on a master_list bucket.

queue.brief: Tactics skirmish aboard a fractured orbital station. 3 player units (a frontline Vanguard, a long-range Sentinel, a support Medic) vs 4 hostiles. Cover-heavy 12x9 grid with a hazard vent strip down the middle. Winnable in 4-6 turns with smart cover use. CRITICAL: every unit must spawn on a floor tile (0), never on a wall (1) or full-cover (3).
queue.history: 2026-05-29 first run: failed (claude -p set view:{camera,zoom} + no title; retry placed an enemy on a full-cover tile). Fix shipped: title/view auto-normalized + prompt now forbids units on blocking tiles.
queue.detail:
blocked from shipping: fidelity=fail (letters (A, B, C) as identifiers",
    "Hex grid is untextured wireframe with no terrain variety or theming",
    "UI elements are plain rec)

queue.brief: Classic 10x10 salvo naval duel vs a competent hunt/target AI. Standard 5-ship fleet. Original IP naval theme.
queue.history: 2026-05-29 first run: failed only on view shape (camera/lookAt) + missing title. Proven to pass after the title/view normalization fix.

queue.brief: Forest-ambush grid tactics. 2 player rangers vs 4 raiders. Dense tree full-cover, a river hazard line, tight 11x9 map favoring flanking. Punishes standing in the open.
